title: Observation Post 7
author: CredoCode
selftext:
Hey! I’ve been a self taught programmer since the 6th grade and have completed projects using 12+ languages. I have also used GML within GMS2 for the last decade or so, C# & Blender to create Unity games for 3D & VR, web, and mobile dev as well.

Basically- I love to make software and I’ve been doing it for a while. But I also love crafting stories and WOAH I’ve never felt more like a kid with clay: 

\-Opus 5.5 on Medium effort the whole way.   
\-2 weeks of development.  
\-Trailer/Ad Clips/Marketing/Demo/Full-Game all made just with Opus and a local file on my PC.

I told it to generate a single exe file that runs the entire game then talked to it for 2 weeks.

\*Free demo on Itch.io as well as the full-version.

\*Coming to Steam Nov. 17th with a free demo as well.
